passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: A marketing-and-advertising restriction on firearm industry members; it regulates neither who may own which firearms nor how sales are screened, which is the dimension the rungs order.
passages.actor_quote: AB 2571, Bauer-Kahan. Firearms: advertising to minors.

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 2571 (2021-2022), which Bauer-Kahan authored; its operative section bars a firearm industry member from marketing a firearm-related product in a manner "attractive to minors". That regulates firearm advertising, not whether the state should "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons" or "require universal background checks on every sale", so it is adjacent on V2 and no passage survives to seat a rung.
